claude.title: Connect Claude Code
claude.body: Install the statusline hook so Claude Code can share its rate limit data with this app.

codex.title: Sign in to Codex
codex.body: Run the Codex CLI once and sign in with your ChatGPT account. This app reads the local session it creates.

stale.claude: Claude Code has not reported for a while. Numbers update again when you use Claude Code.

waiting.claude: Waiting for Claude Code to report rate limits. Send one prompt in any Claude Code session.
